name: rn-doc-runner
description: Local-first Mac application and Chrome extension that automates repetitive nursing-documentation mechanics under RN review.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint:types && npm run build:production && npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run security:scan
scripts.dev: node --import tsx synthetic-ehr/src/server.ts & npm run start --workspace=@rn-doc-runner/desktop
scripts.build:production: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build --workspace=@rn-doc-runner/extension && npm run build --workspace=@rn-doc-runner/desktop
